notes: Curated First Schedule harvest seed. YA 2024/25 includes 12% band; YA 2025/26 (Act 02/2025) widens 6% to 1M and removes 12%. Quotes mirror IRD Tax Chart / PN IT/2025-01.

rules.source_quote: First Schedule progressive rates for YA 2024/25 (resident individual): First Rs. 500,000 at 6%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 12%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 18%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 24%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 30%; On the Balance at 36%.

First Schedule progressive rates for YA 2025/26 (Act No. 02 of 2025): First Rs. 1,000,000 at 6%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 18%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 24%; Next Rs. 500,000 at 30%; On the Balance at 36% (12% bracket removed).
